**Review: About page draft**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "founded in Bristol in 2019" | Allowlisted (Companies House) |
| "a small team of six" | Fine. Team size is a product-team-checked fact. |
| "every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted (Operations) |
| "Over 98% of our customers rate us five stars" | **Unsupported.** This is an invented statistic. The only approved rating claim is "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website". |
| "we buy from gardens we've visited" | **Unsupported.** It isn't on the allowlist and no source was given. Where a tea is grown is an approved fact, but a claim that the team has visited the gardens is a separate sourcing claim. |

**Fixes**
- Replace the 98% line with the approved wording: "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website."
- Cut "we buy from gardens we've visited", or keep it only once the product team confirms it and gives a source. A placeholder would be `[PROOF NEEDED: which gardens the team has visited, and when]`.
- Voice, spelling and banned words are fine. Sam (marketing lead) still needs to approve before it goes live.

**Suggested compliant version**
> Pebblebrook was founded in Bristol in 2019. We're a small team of six, and every tin is packed by hand in Bristol. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. [PROOF NEEDED: confirmation that we've visited the gardens we buy from]
